quarterly_data.quarter: Semtech press release: Semtech Enables 50G Optical Transition for AI-Driven (09-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Semtech announced full production availability of its mobile transport portfolio for 50G fronthaul in 5G-Advanced radio deployments, now shipping in volume: GN2255 CDR with the GN1700TI TIA for 10 km duplex links, GN2255S CDR with the GN1700TI TIA for 15 km bidirectional (BiDi) links, and GN2256 CDR with the GN1700TI TIA for WDM and longer-reach architectures. The portfolio is built on its ClearEdge, Tri-Edge and FiberEdge product families and is designed to scale toward 6G through 2030. Source Photonics CTO Frank Chang is quoted saying Semtech's CDR and TIA portfolio gives it the flexibility and performance it needs across the fronthaul architectures its customers deploy. The release cites Ericsson's and Nokia's new radios as the industry's move to 50G interfaces (they are not stated to be Semtech customers). No revenue or unit figures stated.
quarterly_data.figure: 50G fronthaul CDR/TIA portfolio in full production (10 km duplex, 15 km BiDi, WDM links)
